summary: Verified end-to-end fix for the 10-min guided meditation loading bug. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — GET /api/media returns both meditations with correct SoundHelix URLs (Song-1 for free, Song-2 for premium), GET /api/media/{id} returns full detail with title/description/duration_sec=600/kind=meditation, admin (premium) can access premium item, freshly registered free user correctly gets HTTP 402 on premium, view count increments on successive detail hits, and both SoundHelix URLs return HTTP 200 with audio content. Frontend: logged in as admin (+393331234567 / Admin2026!), Media tab loads, meditation filter chip works, tapping the 'Meditazione guidata: respiro e presenza' row navigates to /media/{id}, detail screen shows correct title, '10 min' duration, description, view counter, and gold 'Ascolta ora' play button; clicking play-media invokes window.open with https://www.soundhelix.com/examples/mp3/SoundHelix-Song-1.mp3 (captured via console). Premium meditation detail also opens correctly for the admin (no paywall). Bug is fixed.

issues: Premium meditation hero image area renders as blank dark rectangle because thumbnail_url may be empty; the code falls back to CATEGORY_IMAGES[data.category], but 'Meditazione' key mismatch (data.category is 'Meditazione' with capital M vs. potential lowercase key in CATEGORY_IMAGES) can prevent the fallback from resolving. Consider normalizing the category key lookup or ensuring seeded premium meditation has a thumbnail_url. Not related to the audio bug fix.

action_items: None for the meditation audio bug — fix is fully verified. (Optional cleanup) ensure premium meditation seed row has a thumbnail_url or verify CATEGORY_IMAGES lookup is case-insensitive so the premium detail hero doesn't render blank.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/media/[id].tsx uses Linking.openURL(data.media_url) — on Expo web preview this triggers window.open with the audio URL, which is acceptable behavior per E1's note. On native devices this will hand the URL to the OS handler; consider expo-audio for inline playback in a future iteration (not required for this bug).
Seed URLs for meditations in /app/backend/server.py were swapped to SoundHelix — good. Consider adding a startup check that pings media_url values to detect broken CDN links early.
seed_data_creation: Test registers one throwaway free user (+3933399xxxxx) per run to verify the 402 paywall path; no persistent seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend login response uses key 'access_token' (not 'token'). Admin phone +393331234567 / password Admin2026! has premium subscription. Media detail testIDs: 'media-row-<id>', 'play-media', 'back-btn', 'kind-chip-meditation'. Login testIDs: 'login-phone-input', 'login-password-input', 'login-submit-button'. On web, Linking.openURL is mapped to window.open — patch it before clicking play to capture the URL.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (already fixed by E1): the two meditation media items were seeded with a Pixabay CDN URL that returns 403 Forbidden, so Linking.openURL opened a page that failed to play. Fix: media_url replaced with https://www.soundhelix.com/examples/mp3/SoundHelix-Song-1.mp3 (free) and Song-2.mp3 (premium) both returning HTTP 200 audio/mpeg. Verified via backend tests + direct URL fetch + frontend click flow.
